name: Antwerp Zoo
tagline: Mensapenvallei gorillas and chimps first, then African penguins — Asian elephants, not African.

practical.transit_note: Adjacent to Antwerpen-Centraal — short walk from main station exits.
practical.best_start: One circuit; don’t chase every house.

items.label: Western lowland gorilla
items.one_liner: Westelijke laaglandgorilla — who looks in charge?

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Western lowland gorilla?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

items.label: Chimpanzee
items.one_liner: Walk between gorillas and chimpanzees — hands used like tools.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Chimpanzee?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

challenges.text: Mensapenvallei: who looks calmest in the gorilla family?
Chimps: spot hands used like tools.
African penguin: watch one bird enter or leave the water.
